summary: RaceJudge picks the idle host's hull from the original nine only when one is free, otherwise any seated hull, so a field of all nine plus the new hulls no longer throws 'Sequence contains no matching element'.
why: The Wrasse, Thresher, Meerkat and Grizzly joined the Regatta card (#2123); a 13-hull field race now runs (host Dolphin, all 13 seats scored).
